text:
alisa: Quick sync — about to merge PR #4521 changing rerank request shape. Main change: scores can be omitted and we'll accept client-provided 'tie_breaker_seed'. Need :thumbsup: or concerns before EOD.

mike: @alisa can you paste the new minimal schema? just want to confirm old clients won't break.

alisa: Sure, from the PR:
```
request: {
  "candidates": [ {"id": string, "payload": object} ],
  "scores": [number] // optional, length == candidates OR omitted
  "tie_breaker_seed": number // optional
}
```

priya: If scores omitted, runtime will use model scores as usual, right? or fallback to model+seed deterministic shuffle?

samir: runtime behavior is: if scores missing -> call scorer component to produce floats. If tie (same float), we use tie_breaker_seed when provided else stable hashing on id. That's backward compatible.

jordan: Small question: what about nulls inside scores array? old clients sometimes send nulls for missing values.

alisa: Good catch. PR handles nulls: null == not scored -> scorer invoked for that candidate only. So mixed arrays supported.

mike: Any change to response payload? like adding 'position' vs keeping 'rank'?

alisa: Keeping 'rank' to avoid churn. We're adding 'score_meta' optional map per candidate for future diagnostics.

priya: LGTM. Could we add an integration test that sends scores=[null, 0.9] and tie_breaker_seed=42 ?

alisa: Yup there's a test in pr: tests/rerank/test_partial_scores.py

samir: One operational note — if scorer is invoked for many nulls, cost increases. Maybe add warning in console telemetry if >20% nulls in request.

jordan: +1 on telemetry. Also can we document that scoring is async under heavy load (may increase latency)?

alisa: Annotated in changelog and API docs draft: https://redwood.dev/specs/rerank-v2

deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging once PR passes CI :rocket:

mike: I'll review the PR now, ping me if you need quick fixes.

alisa: Thanks all. No blockers, merging after CI green. If someone wants to test staging, ping me here.
